package.name: libvips
package.description: A fast image processing library with low memory needs

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/libvips/libvips.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" 24ad4d042940e6bf99a68871ba886ca8847c9c82; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 24ad4d042940e6bf99a68871ba886ca8847c9c82
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach 24ad4d042940e6bf99a68871ba886ca8847c9c82
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "24ad4d042940e6bf99a68871ba886ca8847c9c82: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

pipeline.name: Create a test PNG image
pipeline.runs:
# Create a 100x100 black PNG image using the vips CLI
vips black /tmp/test.png 100 100
test -f /tmp/test.png

pipeline.name: Crop image with vips extract_area
pipeline.runs:
vips extract_area /tmp/test.png /tmp/crop.png 0 0 40 40
test -f /tmp/crop.png
vipsheader -f width /tmp/crop.png | grep -F "40"
vipsheader -f height /tmp/crop.png | grep -F "40"

pipeline.name: Retained formats work and unused loaders are absent
pipeline.runs:
set -eu
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
vips black "$work/source.png" 32 24 --bands 3
for format in jpg png webp; do
    vips copy "$work/source.png" "$work/input.$format"
    vipsthumbnail "$work/input.$format" --size 16x16 -o "$work/thumb-$format.png"
    test "$(vipsheader -f width "$work/thumb-$format.png")" = 16
    test "$(vipsheader -f height "$work/thumb-$format.png")" = 12
done
printf '%s' R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7 | base64 -d > "$work/input.gif"
vips copy "$work/input.gif" "$work/gif.png"
test "$(vipsheader -f width "$work/gif.png")" = 1
vips icc_transform "$work/source.png" "$work/colour.png" srgb
test "$(vipsheader -f width "$work/colour.png")" = 32
vips -l > "$work/operations"
for operation in jpegload pngload webpload gifload icc_transform autorot; do
    grep -F "$operation" "$work/operations"
done
for operation in heifload svgload tiffload pdfload magickload jp2kload jxlload openslideload; do
    if grep -F "$operation" "$work/operations"; then
        echo "unexpected loader: $operation" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done
echo 'PASS: JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF thumbnails, colour conversion and omitted loaders'
